answer: A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The harbor counter is kept in gale and pigment shows each reset. A hostile operator as a result has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 306 aliases cost 343 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
